summary: Big Digital Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a September 18, 2026 Exchange Agreement with Endeavor Blockchain, LLC, wholly owned by Executive Chair Joshua A. Kilgore. Endeavor exchanged $2,568,815.71 of revolving-line debt ($2.5M principal plus $68,815.71 interest) for 442,899 shares priced at $5.80, the prior consolidated closing bid, per Nasdaq Rule 5005(a)(23); the exchange closed September 21, 2026. Section 3(a)(9) exemption applies, with transfer restrictions and legends. Watch related-party dilution, Rule 5005(a)(23) pricing compliance, and any further affiliate debt-for-equity swaps.
